title: Stephen Hawking's submarine trip to possible Atlantis ruins
summary: Kurt Metzger tells of Stephen Hawking's submarine trip to possible Atlantis ruins, about unspecified at underwater ruins (location unspecified), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he went in a submarine to go look at that.

related.note: Both describe Stephen Hawking going down in a submarine in the circle around Epstein. This telling says the dive was to look at possible Atlantis ruins, while the story says it was to study gravitational anomalies in the Bahamas basin.

plain: A comedian named Kurt Metzger says that a man called Fog Daniel told him the famous physicist Stephen Hawking went down in a submarine to look at underwater ruins that some think could be Atlantis, the legendary sunken city. Metzger links the story to National Geographic. If true, it would mean one of the world's best-known scientists took a personal interest in a lost-civilization site.
